border-style.$description: DTCG §9.2 strokeStyle keywords. No consumers today — added for GTC token-type completeness and so design tools carry the vocabulary. NOT representable as a Figma Variable (see FIGMA_SKIP in build.mjs), so designers set it by hand. `none` is deliberately absent: it is not a DTCG strokeStyle keyword — express "no border" as border-width.0.
